formulation: tablet for oral suspension (Jadenu film-coated tablet in the same line from 2015)

launch_evidence.quote: Oncology sales climbed 10% (+15% lc) from ongoing growth for Gleevec/Glivec and Femara as well as the launch of the iron chelator Exjade following US approval in November 2005.

series_start_reason: FDA approval 2 Nov 2005. The Q4 2005 and Q1 2006 reports print no Exjade row; 2005Q4 (2) is read from the prior-year column of the Q4 2006 report and 2006Q1 (19) from the prior-year column of the Q1 2007 report (direct_prior_year_column). The first own-quarter row is Q2 2006 (31).
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2023 interim report (6-K 0001370368-23-000046, a230425-99_2.htm) Novartis prints no Exjade/Jadenu row: the Hematology table lists Promacta/Revolade, Tasigna, Jakavi, Kymriah, Scemblix, Adakveo and 'Other'. The Q4 2022 report (0001370368-23-000008) is the last with the row (Q4 2022 61; FY 2022 323).
notes: One Novartis line for deferasirox: 'Exjade' to Q1 2015, 'Exjade/Jadenu' from Q2 2015 (Jadenu, the film-coated deferasirox tablet, FDA-approved March 2015, is sold in the same line from then on); the Q2 2015 report's prior-year figure (244 for Q2 2014) equals the 'Exjade' figure. Treated as one product line because both brands are the same molecule printed by the issuer as one row; Jadenu is never printed on its own row. Worldwide; no regional split on the product table.
search_log: Listed Novartis AG (CIK 1114448) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages, all form types: 1,431 filings, 937 of them 6-K). Located quarterly results documents with EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) for each brand name (Exjade, Afinitor, Jadenu, Fabhalta, Piqray, Vijoice, Votrient, Tykerb, Arzerra, Signifor) over 2005-2026, restricted to 6-K hits filed in the results windows (Jan-Feb, Apr-May, Jul-Aug, Oct-Nov); 199 documents fetched (6-K bodies 2005-2011, EX-99.1/EX-99.2 from 2010). The union contains every quarterly report 2005Q4-2026Q3, since each prints an Exjade or Afinitor or Piqray row.

Rows extracted by script from every HTML table whose header row begins with 'Qn YYYY' (the quarter table), taking the row whose first cell starts with the brand; the first figure is the current quarter. Where two filings carry the same quarter (2010-2012 duplicates under accession prefixes 0001104659 and 0001370368) the EX-99.2 interim financial report or the 0001370368 filing is cited.
